payload.title: Reject non-text SQLite Conversation payload and continuation values
payload.summary: P2: a valid store-created v1 SQLite database permits BLOB storage classes in TEXT-affinity columns. Public load admits bytes in messages.content/source and conversations.source/value because the reconstructed dataclasses do not validate all string types. Four actual SQL updates reproduce invalid returned state; a fifth Runtime consumer probe forwards a bytes-valued continuation to its deterministic interaction. The strict JSON persistence path rejects wrong value types. No real provider or actual user database was exercised. Baseline 206d58e271014e08cda8d18774b5fc86f406bf84. Acceptance: Validate persisted semantic text at the SQLite decoding boundary before constructing Message/InteractionSource/ConversationRef. Refuse unsupported storage classes as PersistenceFormatError with appropriate causes; do not lossy-decode/coerce bytes. Cover all four demonstrated columns, valid Unicode/empty content, existing timestamp/ID/role/ref failures, duplicate occurrences, shared message identity and Runtime restoration. Keep valid v1 wire/schema and source/identity semantics; no global Model/Conversation redesign.
payload.benefit: Repair the existing Conversation storage contract in its current owner without a new backend, ORM, transaction framework or Evidence store.
payload.uncertainty: Temporary authored databases, deterministic SQLite callbacks/threads and subprocess exits. No user data, live models, power-loss claim or actual autonomous-agent damage. No maintained native store caller beyond tests found.
dependencies: Separate maintainer-authorized bounded implementation with permanent independent regressions and full unchanged protected gate.
B-0027/B-0028 retain broader representation, retention and consumer decisions. Three same-owner findings are independently testable siblings, not automatic duplicates.
